decisions.reason: Having survived several years after launch and carrying an award signal while fitting the core organic yogurt range, it likely meets aspiration levels and uses little additional search or adjustment effort.

As a product once highlighted as a flagship direction in core cheese, its continued presence suggests performance at or above aspiration and management would be reluctant to withdraw it absent clear problems.

This semi-hard cheese is less distinctive than the flagship items, but its survival since 2018 in a growing market indicates acceptable results and enough slack to keep it under review rather than cut it now.

Because the spicy cheese was launched as a multi-variant line in the firm's core category, management is likely to preserve it unless results clearly fall below aspiration, which is not indicated here.

The washed-rind soft cheese remains the most niche and therefore the most vulnerable to portfolio pruning, but surviving after the early review period suggests it is still close enough to aspiration to retain for now.
